pure-announcement.rationale: Reference or research material, not an announcement.

duplicate.rationale: No vocabulary-mismatch concept exists; the eval spec's vocab-mismatch subset currently cites nothing.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Published, cited material; claims checkable at the linked source.

durability.rationale: Quantified, replicated phenomenon: ~80% naming divergence between experts (Furnas 1987); an average query term absent from 30-40% of relevant documents (Zhao & Callan 2010).

actionability.rationale: Carries concrete remedies with effect sizes: stemming/lemmatization, term-weight prediction (50-80% gains), CNF expansion (50-300%).

atomicity.rationale: One phenomenon with its measurements and remedies.
